research_notes: Follow up Santos hours/FTE, actual cessation and leave; clarify pre-2004 paid work, Swan role and dates, and organiser transitions. Do not equate a strategist or adviser title with full-time status.

Initial pass on 2026-09-29 used parliamentary biography/frozen roster, ministerial biography, first speech, Queensland Parliament's March 2015 transcript, employer-confirmation reporting and publicly indexed professional/background searches. Santos-site searches yielded no person-specific employment statement; 2015 annual report URL returned 403. No access restrictions bypassed.

Searches also surfaced an Anthony Chisholm in older economics/Productivity Commission material and the US actor. Identity match to this senator was not established, so those careers are not imported. No verified public professional profile supplying hours was located.

Private-sector classification refers to a commercial resource company; public listing does not mean government control. A historical shareholder/control extract remains a follow-up source, along with primary employment confirmation.

Unspecified or overlapping periods are retained without addition. No qualifying full-time interval is established; both headlines remain null. This is an initial durable record with unresolved gaps, not research completion.
